development_approach.strategy: Single-hook extension per architect arch-prop-1 — add 8 gaode_* keys to existing tool-policy.v1.json; add is_gaode_allowed sibling function to existing policy_registry.py; insert gaode-surface classifier + is_gaode_allowed call BEFORE standard is_allowed in pretool-tool-policy.py main(). Preserve fail-safe on policy load failure, fail-CLOSED only for gaode-scoped missing agent_id, fail-open for non-gaode unresolved roles. Add 7 DO-NOT blocks to non-allowlist agent .md files with verbatim header '## DO NOT (harness-enforced)'; remove/rewrite each existing positive gaode instruction so the prompt no longer instructs invocation (replacement: rednote-only discovery + name+address strings; defer coordinate resolution + intra-city routing to timeline agent in M2 pipeline). Bash command-string data contract (resolves QA OBJ-5): the gaode bash-token, bash-resolved-path, env-var, and network-host matchers MUST receive data['tool_input']['command'] (the raw command string), NOT the WRITE-path list returned by extract_bash_write_paths(). Required design: insert a new pre-check stage in main() between resolve_agent_type and _check_targets — _check_gaode_bash(role, command) that runs all 4 bash-related gaode matchers against the raw command string and exits 2 on first hit. The standard _check_targets continues unchanged for non-gaode write-path checks. A naive 'extend _extract_targets' approach would silently miss tokens in `cd /tmp && python3 wrapper.sh` style commands (where extract_bash_write_paths returns no targets and the loop never runs).
development_approach.validation_approach: QA runs negative tests for each of 6 surfaces × non-allowlist roles (skill, bash-token, bash-resolved-path, network-host, env-var, read-path) and confirms hook exits 2 with correct surface and matched_pattern in stderr JSON; positive tests for canonical timeline/transportation across all 6 surfaces and alias 'transport' normalization; identity-default-deny test with missing agent_id on gaode surface; backward-compat test that non-gaode tool calls behave identically to v1 (no regression in existing role behaviors); grep test that each of 7 banned agent .md files contains exactly one '## DO NOT (harness-enforced)' header and timeline.md/transportation.md unchanged.
